how.title: How Bond Interest Is Calculated

items.title: Interest Before AIT
items.body: Face value × yearly rate ÷ 2. ৳10,00,000 × 9% ÷ 2 is ৳45,000 every 6 months.

items.title: Take Off the AIT
items.body: Bangladesh Bank deducts 10% AIT. 10% of ৳45,000 is ৳4,500, so you receive ৳40,500 each time.

items.title: Add Up to Maturity
items.body: Payments = years × 2. Over 10 years that is 20 payments × ৳40,500 = ৳8,10,000, and your ৳10,00,000 comes back at maturity.

how.example: Example: ৳10,00,000 at 9% for 10 years pays ৳40,500 after AIT every 6 months, which is ৳81,000 a year, or 8.10% of the face value. Rates here are examples, not current rates.

sourcesBlock.title: Where the Numbers Come From
sourcesBlock.body: Interest rates and years to maturity come from Bangladesh Bank’s auction results. The AIT rate is the one Bangladesh Bank deducts from interest payments. You can change it above if your position differs.

items.q: How is Treasury Bond interest calculated?
items.a: Each interest payment is the face value × the yearly interest rate ÷ 2, because interest is paid every 6 months. Bangladesh Bank deducts 10% AIT from each payment. For ৳10,00,000 at 9%, the payment is ৳45,000 before AIT and ৳40,500 after.

items.q: When is Treasury Bond interest paid?
items.a: Every 6 months until maturity. Bangladesh Bank deposits the interest directly into your bank account, and returns the principal at maturity in the same way, automatically.

items.q: How much tax is deducted from bond interest?
items.a: Bangladesh Bank deducts 10% AIT (Advance Income Tax) from every interest payment. You can change the rate in the calculator. Your tax position may differ, and this is not tax advice.

items.q: Where do I find the interest rate and the years to maturity?
items.a: In the Bangladesh Bank auction result. The Treasury Bond Center and the Auction Calendar show the latest results. For a reissued bond, use the years left, not the original tenor.

items.q: What is the minimum amount for a Treasury Bond?
items.a: The minimum is ৳1,00,000, in multiples of ৳1,00,000.

items.q: How do I apply for a Treasury Bond through Midway?
items.a: Apply in the Midway Portal by Thursday 1:00 PM for next week’s auction. You need a BO Account.

items.q: What is accrued interest on a reissued bond?
items.a: Reissued bonds involve accrued interest at purchase, which this calculator does not include. Ask us for the figure for a specific bond.

items.q: Can I sell a bond before maturity?
items.a: Bonds held in your BO Account can be bought and sold in QuickTrade Pro. The price can be higher or lower than you paid. This calculator assumes you hold the bond to maturity.
